race.description: The Pub - Drive Of The Day Pace
race.comment: ASCOT SHOWTIME (2) has been good from back row draws in the last two outings here, racing parked but sticking on both times. A better draw gives her every chance to break through. HEAVENLY TURBO (3) drew on the back row and did some work before finishing third at her latest appearance at this circuit, beaten 3.4 metres. Came from similar barriers to this to win her previous two starts, one here and the other at Newcastle. Big chance. Hard to knock the recent consistency of BARRYS BROTHER (4) who added to a string of top-four results when he came from the second line and finished runner-up here last start. ZACHAROONI (5) brings good form from Newcastle where he was runner-up two back before coming from the back line to be beaten less than 4m last week.
